semgrep-cloud-platform/scan.reason: Semgrep Cloud runs a server-side ruleset that no local hook reproduces, so a finding it raises cannot be cleared from a branch. The current finding, python.lang.security.audit.dangerous-subprocess-use-tainted-env-args, lands on the cmd argument of the subprocess.run call inside run_skill_knowledge in scripts/eval/eval-suite.py and is not exploitable: cmd is a list whose first element is sys.executable followed by a fixed script path, subprocess.run defaults to shell=False, and no shell parses the argv, so the rule's suggested shlex.quote would corrupt the value rather than protect it. Clearing the check needs a triage in the semgrep.dev org UI, which neither CI nor a branch can perform. Tracked on issue #5480.
